item.title: Inside the US military playbook to cripple Iran if nuclear talks collapse
item.description: Deep mistrust between the U.S. and Iran leaves nuclear talks fragile, with analysts warning of a phased military campaign if diplomacy fails entirely.

item.title: Tyreek Hill's court battle with OnlyFans model who accused him of breaking her leg ends with shocking twist
item.description: Tyreek Hill and OnlyFans model Sophie Hall settled their civil case Friday, with Hill reportedly declaring he's heading to Disney World afterward.

item.title: DAVID MARCUS: Virginia Democrats step on a $70M rake and now they're crying
item.description: The Virginia Supreme Court ruled the state's redistricting referendum was illegal because Democrats skipped a required intervening election step.

item.title: What Israel wants from an Iran peace deal: No enrichment, missile limits and strict enforcement
item.description: Israel wants Iran to stop enrichment, dismantle underground nuclear sites, restrict missiles and cut ties to Hamas and Hezbollah, experts say.

item.title: Trump blockade squeezing Iran so hard regime may be dumping oil into Gulf, experts say
item.description: Experts say Trump's blockade is squeezing Iran so hard the regime may be dumping excess crude into the Persian Gulf as storage capacity runs out.

item.title: IDF claims to have taken out Hamas commander who participated in Oct 7
item.description: The IDF announced it killed Hamas Nukhba Commander Anas Hamed in a targeted Gaza airstrike, saying he raided Israel during the Oct. 7 Nova massacre.

item.title: Israeli police say Iran using WhatsApp, Facebook, blackmail to recruit spies as latest attempt foiled
item.description: Iran allegedly uses WhatsApp, Facebook and blackmail to recruit Israeli spies, with payments ranging from $21 to $300,000 across various networks.

item.title: Iranian dissidents seize on Trump remarks about armed resistance, fueling revival of Reagan doctrine
item.description: Trump's comments on arming Iranian protesters reignite debate over whether the U.S. should actively support resistance networks against Tehran's regime.

item.title: US-backed pipeline proposal targets global reliance on Strait of Hormuz amid Iran threats
item.description: The Strait of Hormuz crisis is pushing Gulf states and the U.S. to develop alternative energy routes, reducing dependence on one vulnerable choke point.

item.title: German officials warn Islamist, far-left rhetoric driving spike in antisemitic attacks
item.description: Germany faces a "new normal" of antisemitism driven by Islamist and left-wing extremist networks, according to a nationwide report by the Central Council of Jews in Germany.
